explanation: This unit is 0 at D1 and GO and only turns on at D2. It reaches 8-10 when the agent chose a1 and the last few trials were a rewarded run of a1 choices, mostly early in the episode (trials 10-30); it drops to about 4-5 the trial after a no-reward, 7-9 on a rare transition to S2 after a rewarded streak, 0-2 a couple of trials after a no-reward, and stays 0 at D2 whenever the agent chose a2 and on most trials after about trial 40 (late a1 streaks give only 0-4).
